title: Finding Contract
description: One finding from a finder/reviewer agent, as JSON. The machine-checkable form of the kit's Finding Contract: path:line citation, severity, effort, and a concrete harm scenario. Orchestrating skills pass this schema when fanning out finders so N agents' findings merge mechanically; a single object or an array under `findings` both validate.

scope.description: What was searched/reviewed — the bound on any 'none found' claim.

searched_but_absent.description: Negative results: things looked for and NOT found (evidence of absence, with the search that was run).

claim.description: One-sentence statement of the issue — the claim alone, no rationale.

path.description: Repo-relative file path, from a file the agent actually opened.

line.description: 1-indexed line the finding anchors to, as the code exists NOW.

harm.description: The concrete harm scenario — a finding with none of these is an observation, not a finding.

kind.description: failure: input/state → wrong outcome; newcomer: what concretely confuses a new developer; extension: how many files must change to add a variant, and why.

scenario.description: The scenario itself: concrete input/state → wrong output, or the confusion/extension cost spelled out.

source_rule.description: The rule/invariant the finding traces to (rule file, PROJECT.md section, ADR), if any.

proposed_fix.description: Concrete fix shape, if the agent was asked to propose one.

verdict.description: Set only after a finding-verifier pass; absent on raw finder output.
